vision: Enable scalable, schema-flexible customer data storage by migrating profiles from PostgreSQL to MongoDB, ensuring global compliance, zero downtime, and backward-compatible APIs to accelerate international expansion across diverse markets.
scope: The epic covers full data migration of 2M customer records (150GB) from PostgreSQL to MongoDB, setup of CDC pipelines for dual-write and backfill, index design, validation for parity, and rollback capability. Excludes front-end changes or customer-facing UI modifications.
success_criteria: 100% successful migration with zero data loss
No API contract changes or downtime during rollout
Successful rollback completion within 1 hour if needed

user_stories.title: Design flexible MongoDB schema for international customer profiles
user_stories.i_want: to define a document-based schema supporting country-specific fields without altering other records
user_stories.so_that: new country data structures can be added without schema migrations or downtime

acceptance_criteria.given: a new country requires additional customer fields
acceptance_criteria.when: the schema is updated in MongoDB
acceptance_criteria.then: existing data remains unaffected and new documents include country-specific attributes

user_stories.title: Implement change data capture (CDC) pipeline for PostgreSQL to MongoDB backfill
user_stories.i_want: to configure CDC to stream changes from PostgreSQL to MongoDB continuously during the dual-write phase
user_stories.so_that: data parity is maintained until final cutover with zero loss

acceptance_criteria.given: PostgreSQL updates occur during dual-write period
acceptance_criteria.then: MongoDB contains identical updates with no lag beyond 1 second

user_stories.title: Setup MongoDB indexes for optimized read performance under 50ms latency (p95)
user_stories.i_want: to design and implement indexes matching access patterns used by the existing API
user_stories.so_that: read performance matches or exceeds the current PostgreSQL performance benchmark

acceptance_criteria.then: read latency does not exceed 50ms p95

user_stories.title: Implement dual-write capability in service layer with feature flags
user_stories.i_want: to write customer data concurrently to both PostgreSQL and MongoDB for a controlled rollout
user_stories.so_that: data consistency is preserved during migration while enabling zero downtime

acceptance_criteria.given: dual-write mode is enabled via feature flag
acceptance_criteria.then: both databases receive identical data entries successfully

user_stories.title: Validate data parity between PostgreSQL and MongoDB before cutover
user_stories.i_want: to execute a full record-level parity check between both databases
user_stories.so_that: the migration can be confirmed accurate and safe before final cutover

acceptance_criteria.given: CDC and migration processes are complete
acceptance_criteria.then: results show 100% record equivalence across both databases

user_stories.title: Create rollback procedure to revert migration to PostgreSQL within one hour
user_stories.i_want: to define and automate rollback steps to restore application writes solely to PostgreSQL
user_stories.so_that: in case of migration failure, service stability is maintained

acceptance_criteria.then: system resumes using PostgreSQL fully within one hour without data loss

user_stories.title: Ensure API backward compatibility and zero downtime during migration
user_stories.i_want: to keep API contracts unchanged while switching backend from PostgreSQL to MongoDB
user_stories.so_that: external services and clients experience no disruption or behavioral changes

acceptance_criteria.given: API consumers continue to send requests
acceptance_criteria.when: backend data source changes to MongoDB
acceptance_criteria.then: response structure and latency remain consistent with pre-migration behavior
